s.note: Haggis rolled in oat crumbs and fried crisp, with whisky mustard mayo for the old lodge table.
s.how: Haggis rolled into balls, crumbed in oats and fried crisp, with a whisky mustard mayo. Roll 400g haggis into 16 balls. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and roll in 100g fine oatmeal. Fry at 175C for 3 minutes until crisp and hot through. Stir 120g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and 2 tsp whisky.

s.note: Crisp oatcakes topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill.
s.how: Mix 200g oats with 50g melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water. Press thin, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Top with crème fraîche, 150g smoked salmon, dill and lemon.

m.note: Juniper rubbed venison backstrap in whisky redcurrant sauce, with mash.
m.how: Rub 800g venison backstrap with crushed juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear to rare and rest. Add 60ml whisky, 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly and 150ml stock to the pan and reduce. Mash 600g swede with butter. Roast 800g potatoes.

w.note: Whipped honey whisky cream layered with raspberries and toasted oats.
w.how: Toast 60g oats in a dry pan until nutty. Whip 400ml cream with 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp whisky. Lightly crush 300g raspberries. Layer cream, raspberries and oats in four glasses, finishing with oats on top.

d.note: Scotch, lemon, honey and ginger syrup shaken and served over ice.
d.how: Simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and a sliced 4cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. For each drink, shake 50ml blended Scotch, 20ml lemon juice and 20ml honey ginger syrup with ice. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler and gently float 10ml peated single malt on top. Garnish with a piece of candied ginger.
